x: Congratulations to every one of them, especially to Bobby Burns and Ron Kemp, who had travelled up from Eastleigh for this event. Percy Wright, who keeps a benevolent eye on these lads down there for the Club, must have been very pleased himself with the result.
Owing to a heavy cold and night work respectively, Ron Kemp and Bobbie Burns were non-starters, and we started a bare four but managed to finish in 3rd team position.
